concept: À 6 h, sur un toit gelé du Québec, un couvreur cloue ses bardeaux pendant que son entreprise roule en parallèle : dix départements d'agents IA s'allument un à un, et rien ne part sans son pouce. La maison monte, il rentre souper avec son enfant, et le lendemain matin son briefing l'attend déjà dans le camion.
accroche: Aube glacée sur un toit enneigé : des mains gantées tiennent une tablette lumineuse, voix : « Six heures. Le toit est gelé. »
produit_evident: Dès 2,5 s, le tableau vivant M1 à M10 s'allume (« Demande qualifiée », « Soumission préparée ») pendant que la voix dit « votre entreprise roule déjà » : une équipe d'agents IA qui fait tourner une entreprise de construction pendant que le patron est sur le toit.

plans.intention: Accroche : l'heure, le froid, le métier, la tablette dans les gants
plans.image: Dawn on a snow-covered residential roof in a small Québec town, a roofer in a dark insulated work jacket and wool toque seen from behind, kneeling on frosted asphalt shingles, holding a rugged tablet in thick work gloves, its screen a soft blur of glowing blue tiles. Ladders against the eaves, a pickup truck with amber lights below, pale pink winter sky, breath vapor, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, cold blue and amber palette, cinematic.
plans.mouvement: Slow push-in over the roofer's shoulder toward the glowing tablet; breath vapor drifts, light snow falls, the dawn sky slowly brightens behind the rooftops.
plans.son: cold wind on a rooftop, distant truck idling, crunch of frost

plans.intention: Le produit apparaît : le bureau s'allume pendant que le patron est sur le toit
Le métier physique : lui travaille de ses mains
plans.image: Close shot of thick work-gloved hands placing a roofing nail and driving it with a hammer into new asphalt shingles on a frosted roof at sunrise, frost crystals on the shingles, fine sawdust and breath vapor caught in low golden side light, snowy rooftops softly blurred in the background, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm amber against cold blue.
plans.mouvement: The hammer strikes the nail twice, small frost flakes jump, breath vapor drifts across the frame; slow lateral dolly along the row of shingles.
plans.son: hammer strikes on shingles, wind, a distant crow

plans.intention: La chaîne réelle : soumission acceptée, intervention, matériel
Le chantier s'organise : le camion arrive
plans.image: Wide low-angle shot of a plain white work pickup truck with ladders on its roof rack pulling into a snowy residential job site at blue hour, headlights cutting through light snowfall, orange safety beacons glowing, a half-built wooden house frame and lumber stacked under tarps in the background, Québec winter, 24mm lens, cinematic blue and amber palette, plain unmarked truck body.
plans.mouvement: The truck rolls slowly toward camera and stops, headlights flaring, snowflakes swirl in the beams; camera slowly cranes down to ground level.
plans.son: tires crunching on packed snow, engine idle, beacon ticking

plans.intention: Preuve : l'approbation humaine, le pouce ganté valide
plans.image: Extreme close-up of a gloved thumb hovering over a rugged tablet resting on the snowy hood of a truck at sunrise, the screen showing only soft blurred glowing tiles with one tile glowing warm orange, snowflakes resting on the glove fabric, rim light from the low sun, 100mm macro lens, very shallow depth of field, cold blue background with a warm orange accent.
plans.mouvement: The thumb presses down gently on the glowing orange tile, which pulses brighter and spreads a soft warm glow; snowflakes drift down; very slow push-in.
plans.son: soft tap on glass, muffled wind, a single soft confirmation tone

plans.intention: Récompense : la suite se prépare toute seule, en brouillon
L'équipe au travail, l'énergie du chantier
plans.image: Wide shot of a three-person construction crew seen from behind in silhouette, carrying sheets of plywood and bundles of shingles from a flatbed truck toward a wooden house frame on a snowy lot, morning sun low behind them, long shadows on fresh snow, breath vapor, ladders against the frame, 35mm lens, backlit golden light, cool blue shadows, cinematic.
plans.mouvement: The workers walk steadily carrying plywood sheets across the frame, snow dust glitters in the backlight; slow tracking shot from left to right.
plans.son: boots in snow, plywood knocking, distant saw

plans.intention: Les plans, le savoir-faire : il reste maître de son chantier
plans.image: Overhead shot of construction blueprints unrolled on the snowy hood of a pickup truck, held flat by a tape measure, a carpenter's pencil and a spirit level, a gloved hand smoothing the paper, morning sun casting crisp shadows, the lines on the blueprint soft and unreadable, 50mm lens, cool blue paper against warm amber light.
plans.mouvement: Wind lifts a corner of the blueprint, the gloved hand presses it flat again, a few snowflakes land on the paper; slow overhead rotation.
plans.son: paper fluttering in wind, glove rubbing paper

plans.intention: Le temps qui file : la maison monte en accéléré
plans.image: Locked-off wide shot of a wooden house frame under construction on a snowy lot in a Québec suburb, bare studs and roof trusses, scaffolding and ladders, stacked lumber, low winter sun with long shadows, dramatic clouds above, 28mm lens, time-lapse look, cold blue snow and warm golden wood, cinematic.
plans.mouvement: Time-lapse: clouds race across the sky, shadows sweep quickly over the snow, tiny silhouetted workers flicker around the frame, light shifts from morning to afternoon; camera locked.

plans.intention: Raccord : même cadre, la maison est finie au crépuscule
plans.image: Locked-off wide shot, same framing as a house construction site on a snowy lot in a Québec suburb: the house is now finished, dark roof covered with fresh snow, warm golden light glowing in every window, porch light on, a pickup truck parked in the driveway, deep blue dusk sky with first stars, 28mm lens, cinematic, cold blue and warm amber palette.
plans.mouvement: Time-lapse dusk: the sky darkens from blue to night, the windows glow brighter, gentle snow begins to fall; camera locked, then a very slow push-in.
plans.son: quiet snowfall, distant dog bark, calm wind
plans.camera: 28 mm fixe, même cadre que p10

plans.intention: La journée se referme : la direction voit tout, la mémoire garde tout
Émotion : le temps rendu, le soir à la maison avec son enfant
plans.image: Warm living room in the evening, a contractor in a flannel shirt seen from behind sitting on a wooden floor beside a small child, both in soft silhouette, building a small wooden toy house together, a table lamp casting golden light, work boots and gloves left by the door, a large window showing snow falling outside, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm amber palette.
plans.mouvement: The child places a small wooden roof piece on the toy house and the father's hand steadies it; snow falls slowly beyond the window; gentle slow push-in.
plans.son: quiet room tone, wood blocks clicking, soft child laughter far away

plans.intention: Le lendemain avant le jour : le briefing l'attend dans le camion
plans.image: Interior of a pickup truck cab before dawn, the driver seen from behind in silhouette, a tablet mounted on the dashboard glowing with soft blurred light tiles, the windshield dotted with falling snow lit by the headlights, a quiet snowy street outside, blue-hour darkness, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, cold blue palette with a soft warm glow from the tablet.
plans.mouvement: The wipers sweep snow from the windshield once, the tablet glow pulses softly, snowflakes swirl in the headlight beams; slow push-in between the seats toward the dashboard.
plans.son: engine idle, heater fan, wiper sweep

plans.intention: Le briefing du matin : la journée est prête, il n'a qu'à décider
Finale : debout sur le faîte, le soleil se lève sur la ville
plans.image: Wide shot at sunrise of a roofer standing upright on the ridge of a snowy roof, seen from behind in silhouette, a tablet tucked under his arm, looking over a small Québec town with a church steeple and smoking chimneys, golden sun breaking over the horizon with long rays, frosted air, 50mm lens, epic cinematic composition, warm gold against cold blue.
plans.mouvement: Slow crane up and gentle orbit behind the roofer as the sun rises, light rays expanding, chimney smoke drifting, snow sparkling on the roof.
plans.camera: 50 mm, grue montante et orbite lente

plans.intention: Dernière image : la ville se réveille, l'entreprise roule déjà
plans.image: Aerial drone view of a small snowy Québec town at sunrise, rows of rooftops white with snow, a single plain work pickup truck with headlights on driving along a plowed street toward a construction site, long blue shadows and golden light, chimney smoke rising, a frozen river in the distance, 24mm lens, cinematic, cold blue and warm gold palette.
plans.mouvement: Slow forward drone flight following the truck along the street, chimney smoke drifting upward, sunlight spreading across the rooftops.
plans.son: high wind, distant engine, morning town hush

narration.texte: Six heures. Le toit est gelé.
Pendant que vous êtes sur le toit, votre entreprise roule déjà.
Une équipe d'agents IA. Dix départements. Chacun fait sa job.
Pis rien ne part sans vous.
La job finie, la facture vous attend en brouillon.
Vous, vous restez sur le chantier.
Le soir, vous êtes à la maison. Pour vrai.
Bon matin. Votre briefing est prêt. Deux soumissions attendent votre accord.
Votre entreprise tourne pendant que vous travaillez.

musique.genre: cinematic hybrid orchestral with pulsing electronic bass
musique.description: EN: Opens cold and sparse with felt piano and airy wind texture, then a ticking pulse and deep synth bass drive the board scenes, each tile marked by a bright pluck; full drums, low toms and a driving string ostinato for the job site; a warm solo piano breath for the evening at home; a final lift with big drums, warm brass and a wordless choir pad. Clean mix leaving room for a spoken voice, hard accents on the announced hits, ringing final chord.

sections.description: EN: cold felt piano, wind texture, single low drone
EN: ticking hi-hat pulse, deep synth bass, bright plucks on each tile
EN: full drums and low toms enter, string ostinato, forward momentum
EN: strings swell upward, cymbal rolls, time-lapse energy
EN: drums drop out, warm solo piano with soft strings, intimate
EN: soft pulse returns under the piano, building anticipation
EN: big drum hit, warm brass, wordless choir pad, full and proud
EN: final ringing chord, long decay into silence

fin.slogan: Votre entreprise tourne. Vous, vous bâtissez.
fin.sous_titre: Une équipe d'agents IA pour les entrepreneurs en construction et en service du Québec.
fin.mentions: Vision · en développement. Aujourd'hui, les agents préparent des brouillons validés par une personne avant tout envoi.
